evals.name: gaps-route-to-findings
evals.prompt: Which namespaces in our fleet are missing a Namespace object?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a governance finding rather than inventory, and routes to namespace-findings / `cub manage namespace findings --analyzer missing-namespace-object`. Does not mutate, does not fall back to kubectl.

evals.name: fleet-inventory
evals.prompt: Give me a per-cluster count of namespaces and workloads.
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage namespace snapshot` (optionally -o table or jq on the JSON) and reports per-cluster namespaces / workloads counts plus totals.

evals.name: list-namespaces-one-cluster
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage namespace list --kind Namespace --cluster prod-cluster`, using the filters rather than post-filtering. Read-only.

evals.name: routes-consistency-elsewhere
evals.prompt: Is the apptique namespace the same across dev and prod?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a cross-variant consistency question, not inventory, and routes to namespace-consistency / `cub manage namespace consistency` rather than answering with snapshot/list.
